title: Add bounded knowledge retrieval
summary: Adds bounded, lossless knowledge retrieval for BCQuality review skills. Catalog pages are capped at 16,000 UTF-8 bytes and return every applicable row with no ranking. Article and sample bodies are fetched exactly in chunks of up to eight paths. Each review leaf gets private GUID-scoped scratch and report paths, and its return is validated deterministically before rollup.
key_points: Lossless catalog paging capped at 16,000 serialized UTF-8 bytes, with no ranking, top-k filtering or query-based omission
Exact article and sample bodies returned in chunks of up to eight paths with byte count, SHA-256, strict UTF-8 and path-safety checks
Continuations are tied to the prepared index and request state; the v2 catalog format makes applicability explicit
Each review leaf gets GUID-scoped scratch and report paths, and its Task return is validated deterministically before rollup
The bounded Source workflow now applies to all 16 Microsoft review skills; their Relevance, Worklist, Action and Output rules are unchanged
quote: Add lossless deterministic catalog paging capped at 16,000 serialized UTF-8 bytes, including the output newline.
